Definition: from G4183 and G4698 (figuratively); extremely compassionate:--very pitiful.
BiblicalUsage: Polysplanchnos means extremely compassionate, very pitiful, and James uses it once of the Lord himself. After holding up Job's patience, he says we have seen the end of the Lord, that the Lord is very pitiful and of tender mercy.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that God's pity is not thin or reluctant, but deep and wide, and Job's story proves it.
